name: itakua
description: Itakua knowledge framework: itakua-map to operate a brain, itakua-setup to stand one up, itakua-sync for whatever carries it between machines.

interface.shortDescription: A portable, agent-friendly personal knowledge framework.
interface.longDescription: Operate, set up and sync an Itakua knowledge base: nested nodes, approval-aware slots, portable Drive mappings, and validation tooling. A brain is a folder of plain files and needs no sync.
defaultPrompt: Help me operate an Itakua node safely.
Create a new knowledge base with the Itakua framework.
